children: On September 25, 2026, the company received written notice from NYSE Regulation that it will commence proceedings to delist its units, Class A ordinary shares, and warrants for failing to meet Section 802.01B’s $40 million market cap requirement. Trading on the NYSE was suspended that day, and effective September 28, 2026, the securities may trade OTC under SBXD.U, SBXD, and SBXD.WS. The company has the right to appeal the decision.
